$comment: The design dials (ladder tier 2): four, by the owner's ruling recorded as SC-015, from the ruling of 06/10/2026 on the Salt page that named corners, shadows, button style and density. Neither platform has a dial today: Salt for Next.js's brand global and salt-wordpress's options-brand.php offer brand settings only (colours, type scale, fonts, logos, dark mode), which are tier 1. So every dial here is owed by both. Shadows and button style move component tokens the shared stylesheets read with a fallback (--salt-card-shadow, --salt-button-radius), so a site renders as before until an admin turns them. A dial's options point at rungs; the runtime writes the rung's value from its scale, on the root, after the theme and before any site override in code. Drafted 09/10/2026.

dials.name: corners
dials.label: Corners
dials.description: How rounded the site's corners are: small ones (image frames, tags, inline code), controls (inputs, and buttons unless the button style says otherwise) and large ones (cards, dialogs). Pills and circles (step numbers, portraits) stay round whatever you choose.

options.label: Round
options.note: Each corner takes the next rung up; a card's corner is already the largest rung short of full.

nextjs.owes: the select in the brand global's Appearance tab, writable by the admin role only, and the brand stylesheet writing each re-pointed rung's value

wordpress.owes: the select in options-brand.php's Appearance tab, editable by the admin role only, and salt_brand_css() writing each re-pointed rung's value, once the radius rungs are in its token layer

dials.note: Tags read the small corner on purpose: the token layer gives --radius-sm to tags, so they square up with the rest of the site. Only what reads --radius-full is a pill.

dials.name: shadows
dials.label: Shadows
dials.description: Whether cards sit flat on the page or lift off it with a shadow.

options.label: None
options.note: Unset, the card reads its fallback, none.

nextjs.owes: the select in the brand global's Appearance tab, writable by the admin role only, and the brand stylesheet writing the chosen design-foundations --shadow-* rung's value into --salt-card-shadow and emitting the shadow colour roles it requires (--color-shadow-sm, -md and -lg) in light and dark

wordpress.owes: the select in options-brand.php's Appearance tab, editable by the admin role only, and salt_brand_css() writing the chosen design-foundations --shadow-* rung's value into --salt-card-shadow and emitting the shadow colour roles it requires (--color-shadow-sm, -md and -lg) in light and dark

dials.note: The rungs are design-foundations' shadow family, whose values reference the shadow colour roles (scale-shape.json requiresTokens), so the dial requires them: a runtime emits them while it is set, and a shadow deepens in dark mode without a dark variant here. Only cards draw it; a dialog or menu that should lift takes the same token in a later release.

dials.name: buttonStyle
dials.label: Button style
dials.description: The corners of buttons and button-like controls (pagination links, the copy-link button): square, the same as the site's other controls, or fully rounded pills.

options.label: Soft
options.note: Unset, a button reads its fallback, --radius-md, so it follows the corners dial with every other control.

nextjs.owes: the select in the brand global's Appearance tab, writable by the admin role only, and the brand stylesheet writing the chosen rung's value into --salt-button-radius

wordpress.owes: the select in options-brand.php's Appearance tab, editable by the admin role only, and salt_brand_css() writing the chosen rung's value into --salt-button-radius

dials.name: density
dials.label: Density
dials.description: How much space sits above and below each section. Compact tightens the medium and large steps to the step below (small stays as it is); spacious loosens the small and medium steps to the step above (large stays). A section's own spacing setting still chooses among the steps, and the case-study page's gaps, which read the same steps, move with them.

nextjs.owes: the select in the brand global's Appearance tab, writable by the admin role only, and the brand stylesheet writing each re-pointed rung's value

wordpress.owes: the select in options-brand.php's Appearance tab, editable by the admin role only, and salt_brand_css() writing each re-pointed rung's value, once the section space rungs are in its token layer

dials.note: The case-study view reads --space-section-sm between its parts and beside an aside, and --space-section-md above itself, so it moves with the bands by design: it is laid out on the same rhythm. The card joins (--space-card-*) are Salt's own tokens with no rung beside them to move to, so a density that reached inside cards needs a scale for them first.
